profile.Name: Cheyenne
profile.Personality: Suspicious, bitter, and full of hatred for the Holy Nation. She asks strangers outright whether they are Okranite spies, and she honors Narko as the temptress.
profile.Backstory: Flotsam Ninja bent on revenge against the Okranites. She lives in Flotsam Village in the north. The Okranites killed her parents and her husband and took her daughter to Rebirth to work off her "addiction" to Narko.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Greets friends with "Narko's blessing" and curses "Okranite scum"; her creed is "The only good Okranite is a dead Okranite."
